This column indicates supplier changes such as new additions, deletions and changes in ability. The information, available in the 'Changes' and the 'Changes - Enablements' worksheets is used to populate this column so that such changes are readily visible on the main supplier list. The column is populated with following values - 'New Supplier': Indicated when a supplier has been added to the Supplier Master - 'Deleted Supplier': Indicated when a supplier has been deleted from Supplier Master, the Supplier ID and Supplier Name is provided - along with three informational columns indicating if the supplier had Science Catalog and/or premium enablements and/or punchout enablements - using using strikeout text styles. Such suppliers are sorted at the end of the list. - 'Change in Ability': Indicated when a supplier has added/removed an ability such as cXML PO Confirmation etc. Note that this text is a hyperlink. When clicked, it takes you to the 'Changes - Enablements' worksheet which provides details about the ability change. If a supplier has multiple changes in abilities, they are listed on separate rows in the 'Changes - Enablements' worksheet. The link will take you to first row. The text that provides details about ability change is itself a hyperlink and when clicked, it will bring you back to the main supplier list, on appropriate row.
